importantFindings.title: Preface text merged onto the header's own line rejected the whole answer with a misleading reason, even when every row kept its line break
importantFindings.evidence: src/capabilities/rosterPaste.ts parseRosterPaste inline-header branch always fed the rest of the header line to reconstructJoinedRows and gave up when it held no rows. Repro: 'Ecco il risultato: Cognome;Nome;Data di nascita;Età;Telefono' followed by two intact row lines and FINE gave no candidates and the reason 'gli a capo della risposta sono andati persi'.
importantFindings.impact: Defeats F2 item 1 (a forgiving phone paste) for a plausible assistant slip, and sends the operator to a retry that fails the same way. Nothing saved wrong; visible and editable.

importantFindings.title: A row's malformed, impossible or future date rejected a row whose printed age was valid
importantFindings.evidence: parseRosterPasteRow validated the date before the age and returned ok:false on any date failure. 'Rossi;Anna;1/3/2010;15;', 'Rossi;Anna;30/02/2010;15;' and 'Rossi;Anna;01/01/2027;15;' were rejected although age 15 was given; the order predates F2.
importantFindings.impact: Contradicts the age-only decision (the printed age wins, the date is scaffolding). Visible, not silent.

importantFindings.title: A corrupt stored date of birth crashed the student edit form
importantFindings.evidence: StudentManagement.tsx computed calculateStudentAge in the form's useState initializer; parseDateOnly throws for a value such as 'not-a-date'. Before F2 the form held the raw string and stayed editable.
importantFindings.impact: Needs pre-existing corrupt data (no current entry path produces it), but made such a record uncorrectable through the UI.

qolFindings.title: The placeholder-word list rejects a real surname such as 'Nota'
qolFindings.evidence: rosterPaste.ts PLACEHOLDER_NAMES and isPersonName: 'Nota;Anna;12/03/2010;;' is refused as 'cognome non valido'.
qolFindings.impact: Narrow; the row stays visible and can be fixed in place.
